paragraphs: Savi sells student loan and education benefits that employers and other partner organizations offer to their employees and members. The platform is described as AI-driven, paired with 1:1 expert support for navigating student loan repayment and forgiveness programs. The guidance product scans 150+ forgiveness and repayment plans, estimates savings, automates enrollment, and tracks ongoing updates.

A contribution program reduces employee loan debt, with paperwork handled and direct payments made to loan servicers. Retirement matching lets employers direct matches into employee retirement accounts based on student loan payments. A tuition reimbursement offering covers program management, tax compliance, and employee support for employees in college or job-related courses.

Savi states that it works with more than 10,000 partners, ranging from Fortune 500 companies and startups to associations, financial institutions, hospitals, local governments, membership groups, non-profit organizations, and universities. Savi describes itself as a public benefit company headquartered in D.C. Aaron Smith and Tobin Van Ostern launched Savi in 2017 as a Public Benefit Corporation.

quote.text: Savi is on a mission to help the middle class prosper by tackling the $1.8 trillion in student debt affecting more than 45 million borrowers.
